scientific_integrity: Complete exact combinatorial proof; finite enumeration is only corroboration. Only reduced singular support in the Birkhoff projective embedding is studied.

title: Hilbert series and a non-Cohen–Macaulay singular support for the four-by-four Birkhoff toric variety
